# Ferncastle Payments -- Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

This fictional Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Halvard Systems and Ferncastle Payments covers payment processing and reconciliation services and the commercial terms that apply to it. It is synthetic evaluation data, not legal advice and not a real agreement.

## Term and Renewal

The current term of this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Halvard Systems and Ferncastle Payments runs until 2027-12-18 and renews automatically for an additional twelve (12) month term on the same terms. Either party may prevent renewal by giving notice twenty (20) days in advance of the renewal date; renewal does not change the agreed fees.

## Termination

Halvard Systems may terminate this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement for convenience at any time on one hundred twenty (120) days written notice. Either party may terminate for cause where a material breach remains uncured thirty (30) days after notice, and Ferncastle Payments shall return or delete Customer materials on termination.

## Confidentiality

Confidential Information disclosed under this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement remains the property of the disclosing party. Ferncastle Payments shall return or destroy the Confidential Information of Halvard Systems on request, and confidentiality obligations survive two (2) years beyond termination.

## Governing Law

Governing law and venue. The law of the State of New York applies to this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. Ferncastle Payments and Halvard Systems agree that the courts of the State of New York have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes arising from it.

## Notices

Contractual notices are delivered electronically: Halvard Systems receives notices at contracts@halvard.example.com and Ferncastle Payments at contracts@ferncastle.example.com. A notice is deemed received on the next business day after transmission.

## Signatures

Signed for Halvard Systems by Marit Halvorsen, Director of Procurement. Signed for Ferncastle Payments by Nils Ekstrand, Managing Director. All signatories named in this document are fictional and no real person is represented.
